sphere.ground_truth: analytic unit sphere, image axes +x right / +y down / +z toward camera

horizontal_flip.expectation: exactly the horizontal image axis negates
horizontal_flip.note: in distribution: the config ships flip_pairs, so horizontal flip augmentation was part of training

vertical_flip.expectation: exactly the vertical image axis negates
vertical_flip.note: OUT of distribution: an upside-down person is unlike anything in the training set, so a weaker correlation here is expected and is not evidence against the mapping

checks.test: brow leans up relative to jaw (image -y)

camera.derivation: from the recorded Euler angles: a Blender camera looks down local -Z with local +Y up
